capabilities: Syncs notes and attachments over local Wi-Fi/LAN
Pairs devices via Wi-Fi scan or QR code
Transfers only changed files with incremental hashing
Keeps timestamped copies on simultaneous edits
extras: Desktop host runs a local HTTP server on 0.0.0.0:27123; Windows users may need to allow inbound TCP port 27123 in the firewall for discovery. Sync is strictly manual via ribbon icon or command.
problem: Moving vault changes between desktop and mobile devices normally needs cloud storage, third-party servers, or internet access, none of which this plugin uses.
summary: Manual, offline vault sync over local Wi-Fi/LAN between desktop and mobile devices, with network discovery, QR pairing, and incremental transfers.
